<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR fixes a flaky e2e test for TrainJob. The test previously timed out waiting for a generic "Finished" condition that never appeared. The fix adds explicit assertion for the TrainJobComplete condition with updated imports and a more targeted assertion message in the finish phase.

## Changes

**TrainJob completion status test fix**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **TrainJobComplete condition assertion and imports** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/extended/trainjob_test.go` | Adds `kftrainerapi` import to access the `TrainJobComplete` condition type. Updates the finish phase with a `gomega.Eventually` loop that re-fetches the TrainJob and verifies `TrainJobComplete` condition is true, with explicit assertion message indicating `TrainJob`/`Workload` did not finish. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Poem

> 🐰 A test was waiting, stuck in time,
> For a Finished condition that would never chime,
> Now TrainJobComplete takes the stage,
> With imports fresh and assertions sage,
> The race is fixed, no more delays!

</details>
